_comment: Creature Burn (2026-11-20, Stage 2 batch 2). Cinder Pyromancer end to end in the real game: the opponent is
at 5, we hold one Lightning Bolt with one Mountain, and the un-sick 0/1 Pyromancer is untapped. The Bolt is
red, so the Pyromancer pings IN RESPONSE to its untap trigger and untaps (5 - 1 - 3 = 1); it is HELD home
from combat (a 0-power attack forfeits the ping), and its post-combat lethal finish pings the last point --
a turn-3 win. Without the response ping (Bolt + one end-step ping = 4) the opponent survives to turn 4.
